<!--
请用能准确描述需求的语言填写，中文完全可以，不必翻译。维护者会保留原文，用英文整理分诊记录，并用报告所用语言回复。
Write in whichever language lets you describe the request accurately. No translation is required. Maintainers preserve your original text, keep triage records in English, and reply in the language of your report.
协作语言说明 / Language policy: https://github.com/kamjin3086/chatless/blob/main/docs/agents/language.md

请先搜索已有 Issue 和讨论。如果是现有功能出错，请选择 Bug report 模板。
Search existing issues and discussions first. If an existing feature is broken, use the Bug report template instead.
-->

## Feature description / 功能简介

<!-- Briefly describe the feature you'd like. / 简要描述你想要的功能。 -->

## Problem statement / 使用场景与问题

<!-- What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way today? / 你想完成什么操作？目前遇到了什么困难？ -->

## Proposed solution / 建议方案

<!-- Describe how the feature could work, if you have a proposal. / 如果已有想法，请描述它可以怎样工作。 -->

## Platform coverage / 适用平台

- [ ] Windows
- [ ] macOS
- [ ] Linux
- [ ] All platforms / 所有平台

## Priority / 优先级

- [ ] Low (nice to have) / 低（有了更好）
- [ ] Medium (useful improvement) / 中（有明显帮助）
- [ ] High (important to my workflow) / 高（对我的工作流程很重要）

## Screenshots or prototypes (optional) / 截图或原型（可选）

<!-- Include screenshots or mockups if helpful. Remove sensitive information before posting. / 如有帮助，可附上截图或原型。请先删除敏感信息。 -->
